data.name: Juthamah
data.gender_notes: Juthamah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Battle of Uhud, Juthamah ibn Mut'im Al-Laythi was a powerful Meccan leader who rallied the Quraysh against the Muslims. The name Juthamah means 'Gatherer of People' or 'Leader of the People'. The name Juthamah carries the meaning “Gatherer of People” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Juthamah usually hope their child will grow to embody gatherer of people and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Juthamah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: جُثَامَة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من ج ث م، يعني الغيمة السوداء أو الظلمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: جُثَامَة هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي ج ث م، ويشير إلى الغيمة السوداء أو الظلمة. في اللغة العربية، يرتبط هذا الاسم بالظواهر الجوية والطبيعية، وقد يستخدم في بعض الأحيان لوصف الشخصية القوية أو الغامضة. وفي سياق الأسماء الإسلامية، يُعتبر جُثَامَة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني عميقة ومرتبطة بالطبيعة والكون.

in_urdu.name: جثامہ
in_urdu.meaning: غموں کا بادلوں کی سیاہی یا تاریکی
in_urdu.long_meaning: جثامہ نام عربی جذر ج ث م سے ماخوذ ہے، جو غموں کے بادلوں کی سیاہی یا تاریکی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اردو میں، یہ نام اکثر مضبوط یا پراسرار شخصیت کو بیان کرنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اسلامی ناموں کے سیاق میں، جثامہ ایک ایسا نام ہے جو گہری معانی اور قدرتی عناصر سے منسلک ہے۔

The name may be associated with qualities such as resilience, wisdom, and a deep understanding of the world. Historically, the name Juthamah has been used in various Muslim cultures to signify a person with a strong and enigmatic personality.

data.cultural_impact: The name Juthamah serves as a reminder of the significant role he played in the early Islamic history as a leader of Meccan forces against the Muslim army during the Battle of Uhud. Despite his important role in history, the name Juthamah is less commonly used today as it is associated with his negative actions against the Prophet Muhammad SAW and the early Muslim community.
data.spiritual_significance: Juthamah's name highlights the concept of leadership and gathering people towards a cause, whether it is a positive one towards God or a negative one towards opposing God. As Muslims, we can reflect on this name and strive to be leaders in our communities and families, gathering people towards the path of righteousness and seeking the pleasure of Allah SWT. Juthamah's story serves as a warning against the dangers of leading people towards disobedience and opposing the truth. May Allah SWT guide us all towards the Straight Path. Aameen.
